product.title: Private Singapore Walking Tour: City Highlights & Hidden Gems

description.text: In Singapore, this private licensed walk covers Chinatown, the Civic District, Thian Hock Keng Temple, Marina Bay, and Merlion Park on three-, four-, or six-hour options. The three-hour meeting is Chinatown MRT or Telok Ayer MRT; longer options add hotel pickup in central areas and ports. A local drink is included. Commentary stays on colonial streets, temple architecture, and waterfront landmarks rather than a hawker tasting script. The six-hour window can finish in Kampong Glam or Little India. The format suits visitors who want a guided heritage circuit without assembling Civic District and Chinatown stops independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Singapore, and the itinerary stays on Chinatown, the Civic District, Thian Hock Keng Temple, and Merlion Park that define this walk rather than a Pulau Ubin kayak day.
